## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) (`feat: …`, `fix: …`); it becomes the commit message and the changelog entry
- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`), and images regenerated with `npm run docs:shots` if the UI changed
- [ ] No runtime dependencies added; no prompts, responses or real usage data in fixtures
